items.summary: A United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) report states that drastic emission cuts can restore global warming to 1.5°C by the end of the century. The report details required emission reductions of 18% by 2030, 45% by 2035, and 69% by 2040 compared to 2025 levels.

Abdul Latheef Naha speaks to investigators, psychiatrists and forensic experts to understand how did a homeless man become the target of a group that took it upon itself to punish him and such incidents are recurring.
